data.one_liner: Flutter widgets for iPhone Duo and foldable devices that handle navigation, split‑view and dialog placement.
data.what_it_does: Provides FoldGeometry, FoldScaffold, FoldSplitView and FoldAnchor to adapt UI to folds while preserving widget state. Handles insets, keyboard and dialog anchoring automatically.
use_when: Building apps for dual‑screen or foldable phones
Need custom UI that keeps state across folding/unfolding
avoid_when: You prefer a full UI kit that supplies its own widgets
strengths: No double insets and correct keyboard handling
Dialogs open in the correct half
Works on any device, not just iPhone Duo
weaknesses: iOS fold support requires extra plugin and specific SDK
Only provides layout helpers, no ready‑made UI components
Setup can be verbose for iOS
data.setup_notes: iOS 27.1 SDK required, enable UIScene lifecycle, add FoldableProvider (e.g., from the foldable package) for iOS fold data; no extra permissions needed

alternatives.name: responsive_framework
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers breakpoint‑based adaptive layouts for multiple screen sizes, including foldables
